FACULTY REVIEW
- Faculty Name: Tasnia Hossain (Thn)
- Courses: BIO103 and CHE101
She's a new faculty and I had the opportunity of doing both BIO103 and CHE101 under her last year. Fortunately, I got an 'A' in both these courses without facing much difficulty. So, I've decided to write a detailed review on her.
TEACHING STYLE: 
She uses PPT slides that are clear and concise. She explains everything really well and will draw diagrams on the board to aid our understanding. You're free to ask questions related to her lecture and she'll gladly answer each query until your confusion is cleared. She won't get annoyed. She'll also hold a Q/A session at the end of every class to make sure everyone understood the lecture. She teaches with utmost dedication and tries to make sure that we actually learn something from her class.
ASSESSMENT STYLE:
She took 3 quizzes and counted the best 2. The quizzes were composed of True/False, Fill in the blanks and MCQ questions. The midterm and final exams had short and broad questions, where we had the option to skip a question. All questions are directly from her class lectures and PPT slides. We had a group presentation in BIO103. Each group chose their topic through a draw and prepared PowerPoint presentations. 
BEHAVIOUR:
She's the sweetest faculty I've met so far. Her approachable demeanour and friendly attitude makes the learning environment even better. She interacts with everyone openly and respectfully, while maintaining professionalism. She responded to emails and was available to assist the students during her office hours.
She's also very understanding.  She often postponed quizzes and reduced the syllabus at our request. She highlighted the important slides from her PPTs before our midterm and final exams. This helped us perform better in the exams as there were questions from those highlighted topics.
GRADING: 
Her grading is fair. She's very lenient when it comes to penalizing. As long as you don't leave the paper blank, you'll surely get marks. In fact, we often ended up with extra marks because of her leniency. She gave us extra marks in our presentation as well. She probably doesn't curve, which really shouldn't be a matter of concern since her questions aren't difficult and she goes easy on us while marking. Just pay attention to her class lectures and go through her PPTs. If you're consistent enough, it's VERY EASY to secure a good grade.
OVERALL COMMENT:
She's a wonderful teacher and great for learning. If you give a little effort, you can easily secure a good grade. Try to be active in her classes. Remember, class participation and consistency is the key here. See less
